text:
devon_acme: Hi team — after we migrated to the new org layout last night several of our engineers get a 403 when opening project consoles. No role changes on our side. Example: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/acme-payments -> 403. Can you check?

anya_support: sorry to hear that — can you paste the user email or ID and one example request id / x-request-id from the failed page load? also which users are affected (all members or a subset)? :thinking: 

devon_acme: attaching the headers we see in the browser console for one failing user: 
```
GET /api/v1/projects/acme-payments/metadata  HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
X-Request-Id: req_0a1b2c3d
User: alice@acme.com
```
The page shows a console-level 403 with a small JSON response: 
```json
{ "error": "permission_denied", "reason": "user_missing_project_role", "missing": ["project.viewer"] }
```
Only some members impacted — team leads fine, individual contributors blocked.

anya_support: thanks — that's helpful. quick check: are those affected users members on the org level or invited directly to the project? did they come via an IdP group mapping?

devon_acme: They were in an IdP group mapped to org-level role "member" before migration. We did switch to granular project memberships in the console at ~02:00 UTC and then started seeing issues. We didn't intentionally change group mappings.

ben_sre: bumping in. I'm going to query the internal authz service for one of the failing users. can you confirm the org id? I think it's org_8041.

carmen_prodops: FYI — we saw some flaky runs of the membership-syncer on 02:05-02:15 UTC yesterday during the migration window. tickets show it errored on rate limit from IDP (429). could be partial syncs leaving gaps.

ben_sre: running internal check now — using admin API: 
```bash
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  "https://internal.redwood/api/admin/v1/orgs/org_8041/projects/acme-payments/permissions?user=alice@acme.com" | jq
```
result: 
```json
{ "user": "alice@acme.com", "project_roles": [], "inherited_org_roles": ["member"], "effective_roles": [], "inherited_deny": false }
```
that shows alice is still an org.member but not granted project.viewer (we rely on explicit project membership for new org layout).

anya_support: ok that matches the frontend error. two paths: (A) restore the old inheritance mapping (if you want org.members to automatically get project.viewer) or (B) re-run a complete membership resync / grant direct project roles. Which is preferred for you?

devon_acme: ideally we want org->project inheritance restored for now — we have hundreds of members and adding per-project roles is tough. is restoring safe?

ben_sre: it's safe but needs an org-level config toggle. I can't flip it from support side without audit. I can offer a temporary manual resync while product ops enables the inheritance toggle. Alternatively we can schedule a full backfill job. Note the membership-syncer logs showed several 429s; if IdP rate limits continue, backfill may need to run with backoff.

carmen_prodops: I can enable the legacy inheritance flag for org_8041 — doing a quick check on implications. Will update audit log. once enabled, the system should materialize project roles for org members. 

authz-bot: Scheduled job start: membership-backfill-org_8041 at 2026-03-15T10:12:00Z. ETA ~5m. job_id=job_8f7e

ben_sre: seeing job progress in logs: 
```
[10:12:03Z] job_8f7e: fetching org members (cursor null)
[10:12:10Z] job_8f7e: processing batch 1/12 (1000 users)
[10:12:22Z] job_8f7e: idp: 429 Too Many Requests on group-sync endpoint — retrying after 8s
[10:12:31Z] job_8f7e: processed batch 1/12 (1000 users) -> 980 succeeded, 20 pending
[10:12:44Z] job_8f7e: processing batch 2/12
```
we're throttling back off and doing retries. good sign: some project roles are being materialized.

devon_acme: thanks — will this cause downtime or any change to user tokens? can't have a production incident.

anya_support: no downtime expected. tokens/scopes are unchanged. the backfill only writes project role bindings for users. It's audit-logged. If you prefer, we can run backfill on a rolling window (non-peak) or give you an ETA for full completion.

ben_sre: ETA ~ 20 mins given current retry rates. I recommend enabling inheritance toggle as permanent fix (product to confirm). Carmen, can you confirm toggle enable?

carmen_prodops: enabled org-level project inheritance for org_8041 at 2026-03-15T10:14:00Z. Audit id: audit_449. Also set membership-backfill to aggressive retry for this run only.

authz-bot: job_8f7e: completed at 2026-03-15T10:31:02Z. summary: 11845 members processed, 11845 project.roles.materialized=project.viewer, 45 failures (to be retried).

ben_sre: spot-checked alice@acme again: internal permission call now returns project.viewer in effective_roles. 
```json
{ "user": "alice@acme.com", "project_roles": ["project.viewer"], "inherited_org_roles": ["member"], "effective_roles": ["project.viewer"], "inherited_deny": false }
```
front-end load should be fixed for previously blocked users — can you confirm @devon_acme?

devon_acme: just checked with alice — console access restored, thanks! 👍

anya_support: great. next steps: we'll keep an eye on the remaining 45 failures and retry them overnight. Carmen will follow up with you about whether you want to keep inheritance on or switch to manual project invites. Also I've opened support ticket S-2026-3129 and linked the audit id.

carmen_prodops: follow-up note: reason for partial gaps = idp group sync 429s during org migration window. we recommend customers migrating large orgs to schedule migration during a window and/or increase IdP rate limits. for now leaving inheritance enabled; if you want stricter perimeter we'll help flip it and run a scoped backfill.

devon_acme: appreciated — please keep us posted on the remaining 45. and thanks for the fast response.

eng-oncall: adding a small mitigation in authz syncer: increase exponential backoff ceiling and write a jitter to avoid thundering herd. we'll PR today, but it's not needed to keep access fixed for you now.

anya_support: closing thread — re-open if any users still see 403 after 10:00 UTC. thanks everyone :party-parrot:
